description: Returns the European Central Bank's euro reference rate for a currency on a given date (or the last rate before it, on weekends and holidays), and optionally converts an amount to or from euro. Use it for invoices in foreign currency.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. CHF, USD, CZK.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. the invoice date. Default: today.

direction.description: to_eur (default): the amount is in the currency and is converted to euro. from_eur: the amount is in euro.

name: get_exchange_rate
title: Get ECB exchange rate
